Andhra Pradesh High Court Criticizes Police Over Minor's Detention

The Andhra Pradesh High Court has criticized police actions in multiple cases. In one instance, the court declared the remand order for a 17-year-old boy, sent to judicial custody for theft, as illegal and without jurisdiction. The court also directed the CID to expedite its investigation into an e-stamps case and sought details from the DGP regarding a minor girl's kidnapping.
